Subject: Handoff & Kickoff: Solaris Health implementation plan and owner assignment

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Per our contract (attached SOW), Solaris Health is set to go live on the Dedicated plan with initial capacity for 4x8 GPUs, and your go-live target is the week of Aug 18. I wanted to introduce our Customer Success and Solutions Engineering leads so we can get a kickoff on the calendar and align on scope.

High-level deal context (quick bullets):
- Deal ID: RINF-2025-0127, ARR: $420k/year, committed Dedicated capacity (4 nodes).
- Contract signed: 2025-07-15 (see attached signed_SOW_Solaris_20250715.pdf).
- Primary success metrics: 50ms p95 latency on standard 2k token gen at 100 RPS sustained; end-to-end inference cost targets for finance team.
- Data/security notes: Solaris requested SSO (SAML 2.0), SOC2 evidence in procurement (provided), and custom retention policy for health records integration.

Proposed owners and roles:
- Marissa Cole (CS) — Customer Success Lead, will own onboarding, adoption plan, and weekly checkpoints.
- Monica Patel (SE) — Solutions Engineering, will handle network access, SSO, performance validation, and runbooks.
- Rishi Malhotra (Sales Manager) — escalation and commercial contact for any scope/contract questions.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can we lock a 60–75 minute kickoff meeting the week of July 28 to go through architecture, access, and success criteria? Alex/Priya: please suggest two slots that week.
2) Solaris: please confirm the team members who will join (identity admin, infra lead, app owner).
3) I’ve attached a proposed kickoff_agenda_solaris.xlsx and a network_requirements_checklist.docx — Monica, please own a short pre-kickoff checklist with Solaris’ infra team.

Attachments:
- signed_SOW_Solaris_20250715.pdf (SOW)
- kickoff_agenda_solaris.xlsx (proposed agenda)
- network_requirements_checklist.docx (network/IP/ports checklist)

Marissa / Monica — please reply to confirm you’ll own the onboarding and any timing constraints. I’ll coordinate calendars once Alex/Priya propose slots.

Thanks — excited to get started.

—

Thanks Dev — excited to kick this off. We can do the week of July 28; two good slots for our team are:
- Tues 29 Jul, 11:00–12:15 PT
- Wed 30 Jul, 09:00–10:15 PT

Attendees from Solaris: myself (product lead), Priya Menon (engineering manager), Jorge Ramos (infra lead) — I'll loop Jorge after this note.

A couple quick clarifying questions before kickoff: 
1) SSO: we intend to use our Okta tenant via SAML. Do you have a standard metadata endpoint plugin or do we need to exchange metadata XML?
2) Data flows: we will be routing inference inputs that include PHI — we need confirmation on data-at-rest encryption in the Dedicated environment and whether any syslog/audit hooks are available for retention beyond 90 days.
3) Sandbox env: can we get an isolated staging environment with reduced throughput (1 node) for integration testing before we ramp to Dedicated?

If you can put proposed owners and a short pre-kickoff checklist in your calendar invite that would be super helpful.

Onward —
Alex
